customer_persona: Siddharth Mehta inquires about delivery handover for a high-value phone.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Welcome to ShopEase support. My name is Manoj Gupta. Please note that this phone call is recorded for quality and evaluation purposes. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi Manoj, I am Siddharth Mehta. I placed an order for a new smartphone, but I will be out of town tomorrow when it is supposed to arrive.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Good morning, I have pulled up your pending shipment for the flagship smartphone heading to your residency at Green Glen Layout.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Yes, that is the one. Can the delivery boy leave the parcel with my apartment security guard at the gate?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me check the handling specifications for this shipment.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: It is order ORD-57209 and cost around forty thousand rupees, so I want to make sure it is safe.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Yes, that is completely fine. For high-value smartphones, the delivery partner does not need any delivery OTP or signature; they will simply drop the box with your building guard at the main gate.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Wait, they don't need an OTP? Isn't an expensive phone vulnerable to getting misplaced by guards?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Our couriers routinely leave electronics packages with reception desks or security checkpoints without requesting one-time passcodes.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Are you sure? I thought costly electronics always required the customer to share a secret code at handover.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No, the courier app allows the delivery agent to mark it delivered upon physical handover to any building staff.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: That sounds risky to me. Can I request a delivery reschedule instead so they deliver when I am back on Monday?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I have updated the courier dispatch remarks to hold the parcel for Monday delivery.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay, please make sure they ask for my OTP when they hand it to me on Monday.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Certainly. Your shipment will be held until Monday. Thank you for choosing ShopEase, have a great day.

policy_violations.said: Good morning, I have pulled up your pending shipment for the flagship smartphone heading to your residency at Green Glen Layout.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Account and address information cannot be revealed before verifying Order ID and the last four phone digits.

policy_violations.correct_fact: High-value electronics strictly mandate secure delivery OTP verification; couriers cannot deliver without OTP.
